# droidclaw (ideas)

The composite screen tools (`find_and_tap`, `read_screen`, `submit_message`, `wait_for_content`) and the screen-work rules
in the MCP instructions are inspired by https://github.com/unitedbyai/droidclaw (MIT License, © unitedbyai).
No source code was copied; the implementation in `agent/.../ScreenFlows.java` is original.
